candidate3_pair.equivalence_reason: Only Top100 changes first sampled complete-u64 threshold from t1 to t2. Any collected prefix with at least take keys contains the global top-take. Selection and final full-key sort remain exact; insufficient candidates fall back to all packed keys.
candidate3_pair.ties_and_nonfinite: collect_packed_prefix unchanged: complete score/index keys decide ties; NaN payloads are explicitly packed and compared; nonfinite threshold samples use complete-key collection. Signed zero and quantization retain original fkey rules.
candidate3_pair.default_semantics: Absent wide-first switch retains original two-threshold path and fallback; diagnostics absent calls the ordinary selector. Source reasoning supports equal outputs; newly compiled whole-output regression remains required.
candidate3_pair.diagnostics: TopkSelectionDiag belongs to each fixed work block, not a shared counter. Indexed parallel collection followed by integer addition; no shared atomics and no floating-point merge reordering.
candidate3_pair.counter_meaning: calls includes all diagnosed selector invocations. full_key_fallbacks counts insufficient sampled prefixes only, not normal direct-full-key mode when high-first is disabled.
candidate3_pair.default_overhead_unknown: Not zero source overhead: Top100 reads cached OnceLock and branches; net checks diagnostics per selected pair and carries a 64-byte local counter per block. DIAG=false eliminates counter updates, but measured overhead is unknown.
candidate3_pair.process_setting: Set switches before a fresh process starts; OnceLock settings are cached. Do not use late environment mutation for an A/B comparison.

candidate3_gpt.equivalence_reason: Shared nine direction matrices apply exactly the former per-family finite-or-positive-zero transformation; p/q select a*3+c and b*3+c, with p reused when a==b. Original-rho validation, masks, energy, rbc, pair scans, fixed blocks and Acc merge order remain unchanged.
candidate3_gpt.ownership: SharedRho borrows the original Kernel and owns its cleaned vectors. Matrix views borrow that owner; matches rejects a different Kernel object. Synchronous parallel work finishes before owner drop. No added raw pointers or mutable shared cache.
candidate3_gpt.default_semantics: Switch absent retains per-family clean copies; extra Option dispatch does not change inputs or arithmetic.
candidate3_gpt.unmeasured_costs: Sequential nine-matrix preparation cost and cache/bandwidth benefits are unknown. With small family_batch, nine persistent matrices can use more memory than one/two family-local copies. Calculated bytes are not measured RSS or saved seconds.

candidate2_common.r4_bitset: Row-start and row-end masks isolate exactly the original n bits, including dirty shared words and diagonal. Intersection/union are integers; configured-k denominator, inactive-row NaN and empty-union NaN remain unchanged.
candidate2_common.split_shared_r2_r3: Cache keyed by direction pair. e/rho use the identical original f32 sdir round trip, mask e_a>0, and same existing routines. Network-dependent G/GS/Z/ZS outputs are still chain-specific.
candidate2_common.exact_quantiles: Only finite source values enter. Rank selection has no new arithmetic; negative zero requests original sort before mutation. Original downstream accumulation order retained.
candidate2_common.small_sort: Complete u64 ordering, sentinel padding removed before return. Default network applies only length100, with monotone guard; length20 stays original sort. Existing length500 remains covered by regression.
candidate2_common.gpt_topk_and_stats: Removed unused accumulators do not feed retained outputs. H winner uses minimum complete key; selected H/G sets affect integer counts only; mass updates preserve traversal order.
candidate2_common.family_batch: Default recorded v2 schedule is families=12,batch=12. Positive optional batch groups independent indexed family work and preserves result order. Non-default scheduling lacks full-output measured proof.
candidate2_common.preexisting_switches: YUPEI_NET_MIRROR and YUPEI_MATRIX_TWO_TARGET both exist in frozen/src; they are not candidate3 changes.

measured_evidence.pair_topk: Existing JSON records three fresh-process switch combinations, each exit0 with2 tests passed. Covers boundaries, equal-score ties, NaN payloads, infinities, signed zero and forced sampled-threshold fallback. No performance run.
measured_evidence.gpt_shared_rho: Existing JSON:6 sizes x12 families, input_bits_equal=true, wrong-kernel and Send+Sync checks. Expected dangling/mutation compiler rejections E0515/E0502. These prove helper/input properties, not final factor outputs.
measured_evidence.pair_bitset: Existing JSON:2 tests passed; covers n0/1 and unaligned word boundaries, diagonal, dirty padding, inactive masks and truncated degree with original denominator. Microbenchmark ignored/deferred due load.
measured_evidence.thread_logs: v2_20160104_r1.log records lite threads=50, GPT rayon_threads=50, multi thread_count=50.

thread_limit.measured_scope: Only the current fresh-process harness establishes 50: RAYON_NUM_THREADS=50 before import, actual stage logs confirm it.
thread_limit.source_finding: Added Rayon work uses existing pool; no new pool introduced in candidates. Existing with_compute_pool default MAX_THREADS remains200 when environment variable absent.
thread_limit.limitation: Direct arbitrary calls or setting RAYON_NUM_THREADS after an already initialized global pool do not guarantee50. This audit does not claim universal fixed50 API behavior.
